responsibility: Defines the command-line target options for the LM32 port and binds them to backend mask bits. The options describe which optional architectural features—in particular multiply, divide/modulus, barrel shift, sign extension, and user-defined instructions—are available, and the generated option state is then consumed by lm32.h builtins/specs, lm32.cc hook logic, and lm32.md pattern predicates and costs.
same_name_distinction: Is the option-definition file for the LM32 stem group: it declares target-specific command-line switches and binds them to backend mask bits like MULTIPLY_ENABLED, DIVIDE_ENABLED, BARREL_SHIFT_ENABLED, SIGN_EXTEND_ENABLED, and USER_ENABLED. Those flags are then consumed by lm32.h macros, lm32.cc logic, and lm32.md predicates/pattern choices rather than implemented here.
